interface Animal {
  name: string;
}
interface Dog extends Animal {
  bark(): void;
}
function combine<T>(a: (x: T) => void, b: (x: T) => void) {
  return (x: T) => {
    a(x);
    b(x);
  };
}
const f = combine(
  (x: Animal) => console.log(x.name),
  (x: Dog) => x.bark()
);
f({ name: "dog", bark() { console.log("woof"); } });
const g = combine(
  (x: { id: number }) => console.log(x.id),
  (x: { id: number; tag: string }) => console.log(x.tag)
);
g({ id: 1, tag: "a" });
type Arg<T> = T extends { a: (x: infer U) => void; b: (x: infer U) => void } ? U : never;
const arg: Arg<{ a: (x: { id: number }) => void; b: (x: { tag: string }) => void }> = { id: 2, tag: "b" };
console.log(arg.id, arg.tag);
